title: U.S. House · Nevada's 4th District
area: North Las Vegas and a broad swath of rural central and southern Nevada, stretching from the Las Vegas Valley to Pahrump and the state's rural counties.

context.text: The Democratic primary was canceled after incumbent Steven Horsford (D) faced no primary challenger and advanced automatically. Cody Whipple won the Republican primary. Independent American Party candidate Russell Best and no-party candidate William Johnson also qualified for the general-election ballot; Gary Steele (No Political Party) withdrew or was disqualified.

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he answered "mostly no" to deporting all undocumented immigrants, supporting the removal of dangerous criminals but opposing indiscriminate mass deportation.
positions.quote: indiscriminate mass deportation that sweeps up hardworking people and terrorizes communities makes us less safe, not more.

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he said Congress should not pass the SAVE America Act.
positions.quote: This bill threatens the freedom to vote to solve a problem that does not exist

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he agreed that President Trump's tariffs have harmed Nevada and said he introduced the RELIEF Act to refund tariff costs to small businesses.
positions.quote: The Supreme Court ruled he lacked the authority to impose them under emergency powers, yet Nevadans already paid

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he answered yes to reinstating Affordable Care Act premium subsidies and no to the Medicaid work requirements.
positions.quote: These 80-hour rules do not create jobs

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he said he supports higher taxes on billionaires and large corporations but not across-the-board increases.
positions.quote: on billionaires and mega-corporations that have long dodged their fair share.

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he said he supports Israel's defensive systems such as Iron Dome and also supports conditioning or withholding assistance that fails U.S. law, civilian-protection and security tests.
positions.quote: I support conditioning or withholding assistance that fails those tests while pursuing lasting peace, security and dignity for Israelis and Palestinians.

priorities.text: Lists making housing, healthcare, groceries and energy more affordable as an issue.
priorities.quote: Make housing, healthcare, groceries, and energy more affordable.

priorities.text: Lists eliminating taxes on tips and defending overtime pay as an issue.
priorities.quote: Protect tipped workers by eliminating taxes on tips and defending overtime pay.

priorities.text: Lists protecting Medicaid and Social Security by eliminating waste, fraud and abuse as an issue.
priorities.quote: Eliminate waste, fraud, and abuse to protect this vital safety net.

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he answered yes to passing the SAVE America Act.
positions.quote: Voting should be easy, but cheating should be impossible

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he answered "mostly no" to reinstating Affordable Care Act premium subsidies and yes to Medicaid work requirements with existing exemptions.
positions.quote: The Affordable Care Act is set up for those who make too much for assistance programs like Medicaid

statements.quote: This is one of the tools in the President's tool box to restore fairness and protect workers.
statements.context: In his Nevada Independent questionnaire answer on whether Trump's tariffs have harmed Nevada (he answered 'In the middle')

statements.quote: He is a strong advocate for school choice, career and technical education, and expanding youth sports opportunities to ensure every child has the chance to succeed.
statements.context: On his campaign website's About section

sources.title: Where do the candidates in Nevada's 4th Congressional District stand on the issues?

researchNotes: Federal key votes and FEC finance totals for Horsford are added separately by script. No campaign website, public statements, or Candidate Connection survey were found for Russell Best or William Johnson beyond their ballot qualification. Cody Whipple: campaign site codyk4congress.com (About and Issues pages) and the Nevada Independent questionnaire were loaded; positions on the SAVE America Act and ACA premium subsidies come from his questionnaire answers, with tariffs and school-choice statements and priorities from the questionnaire and his site. His other answers (immigration, Iran, Israel) are summarized rather than quoted in the questionnaire, so they were not added. Russell Best (Independent American Party; the Nevada Independent lists a campaign link that is a Facebook profile) and William Johnson (no website found): no public issue statements found. Cody Whipple's campaign website and a Nevada Independent profile were used for his biography. No campaign website, public statements, or Candidate Connection survey were found for Russell Best or William Johnson, and no biographical information about Johnson was found.
